name: Fertőszentmiklós (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over green, charged at the centre with the town arms of Fertőszentmiklós (a red shield with a white church, a star and a crescent, bordered in yellow) above the name FERTŐSZENTMIKLÓS in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
